text:
Type: textured knitted throw
Use: warmth on a sofa, armchair or bed, layering; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: soft chunky knit yarn, ribbed knit hems
Colors: medium grey, white
Shape: long rectangle with fine horizontal stripes in a raised bubbly stitch, solid grey ribbed borders at the ends, soft and drapey
Feel: cozy, soft, relaxed, warm
Goes with: white or charcoal sofas, light wood, wool, black accents; Scandinavian, minimalist or contemporary rooms
